title: StratLoom describes AI-assisted curriculum development and literacy instruction
summary: StratLoom describes AI-assisted curriculum work and supervised prompt practice in its Digital Roots programs; it publishes no evidence that learning or educator efficiency improved.
account: StratLoom's public site describes AI-enhanced curriculum development, AI-integrated instructional workflows and supervised prompt practice within its Digital Roots programs. The company presents this AI-assisted instructional work as intended to benefit educators and learners. The site names no pilot school. It gives no participant-level data and no comparison group. It offers no evidence that AI caused the broader training outcomes that the organization claims.
